metadata.description: Claude Code mods by ovidb: guard rails, live progress and readable reports.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows exactly what they would delete or discard before you approve them.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: A live band and panel showing every subagent: what it is doing, its model, its steps and roughly what it costs.

plugins.name: you-should-know
plugins.description: A cheap second reviewer that flags consequences of a turn you might miss, above the prompt.

plugins.name: session-report
plugins.description: Writes a readable HTML report of the session: turns, cost, files changed, commands, subagents and notes.
